title: Bloodtooth Camp

'''Bloodtooth Camp''' is located in [[Ashenvale]] just west of the [[Falfarren River]] and southwest of the southern [[Moonwell (Ashenvale)|Moonwell]]. As its name implies, it is the camp of a tribe of [[furbolg]]s led by [[Ran Bloodtooth]]. These furbolgs have all been corrupted, and are hostile to any outsiders.
